📐 Mathematics — Learn to Solve, Not Just Memorise

At Divya Classes, Mathematics is taught step-by-step so students understand the method behind every answer.

  • Concepts explained from basic to advanced
  • NCERT-focused practice + exam-style questions
  • Formula revision, problem-solving and timed practice
  • Regular tests to find weak chapters and improve scores

🔬 Science — Understand Every Concept Clearly

Physics, Chemistry and Biology are connected to clear explanations, diagrams and exam-oriented practice.

  • Physics: concepts, numericals and applications
  • Chemistry: reactions, concepts and important questions
  • Biology: diagrams, processes and NCERT-based revision
  • Image-based, assertion-reason and competency-style practice

Online MCQ Test — 20 Questions

Every student receives one of 50 randomized question sets. Each set contains 20 MCQs for focused exam practice.

📝 CBSE Pattern Practice Paper

20-question paper: 10 MCQs + 4 Assertion-Reason + 4 Short Answers + 2 Long Answers. Each subject has 100 generated paper sets so students receive a different paper set. Papers are designed for high-priority revision from the syllabus and CBSE-style question formats; no question can be guaranteed to appear in the board exam.

📚 Our Sample Paper

Practice papers created by Divya Classes using recurring CBSE question styles seen across the recent six-year CBSE/SQP archive. Questions are newly written or adapted with changed values, numbers and situations; official papers are not reproduced word-for-word.

How it works: Select your subject → get a Divya Classes sample paper → solve it like a real CBSE paper → download/print it. The questions are original/adapted practice questions, not a reproduction of copyrighted CBSE papers.
